classes.name: crack
classes.description: Structural, hairline, or pattern cracking in concrete or masonry

classes.name: spalling
classes.description: Surface deterioration, flaking, or delamination of concrete

classes.name: exposed_rebar
classes.description: Visible reinforcement steel due to concrete cover loss

classes.name: corrosion
classes.description: Rust staining or active corrosion of reinforcement or steel elements

classes.name: efflorescence
classes.description: White crystalline deposits on concrete surfaces caused by water migration through the material

classes.name: scaling
classes.description: Peeling or flaking of the finished concrete surface due to freeze-thaw cycles or chemical exposure

classes.name: honeycombing
classes.description: Voids and air pockets in concrete due to improper compaction during placement
